- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Weekly/monthly checks include cleaning the bike, lubricating the chain, checking brake pads, tire inspection, and cable tension.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Every 3-6 months checks include deep cleaning the bike and inspecting/replacing worn parts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Every 6-12 months checks include taking the bike to a professional mechanic for a thorough overhaul.
